appDescription.promotional: Transform your daily activities into a beautiful visual map. Track, analyze, and optimize how you spend your time.
appDescription.description:
StackMap is a revolutionary visual activity tracker that transforms how you understand and manage your time. Instead of traditional calendars or to-do lists, StackMap presents your daily activities as colorful, interactive cards that you can easily arrange and track.

Key Features:
• Visual Activity Cards - See your day at a glance with beautiful, color-coded activity cards
• Smart Time Tracking - Built-in timers help you track exactly how long you spend on each activity
• Flexible Organization - Drag and drop cards to plan your day or reflect on how you spent your time
• Progress Insights - Watch your productivity patterns emerge with visual completion tracking
• Offline First - Works completely offline, syncs when you're ready
• Privacy Focused - Your data stays on your device unless you choose to sync
• Multiple Users - Perfect for families or teams sharing devices
• Custom Activities - Create your own activity types with custom icons and colors

Whether you're a student tracking study time, a professional managing projects, or anyone wanting to understand where their time goes, StackMap makes time tracking intuitive and enjoyable.

No subscriptions, no ads, no account required. Just a simple, powerful tool to help you make the most of your time.
